wiltodelta-remove-ai-watermarks-provider.description: Run hash-bound Google, OpenAI, Microsoft, Meta, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Resemble, or Kling watermark-oracle checks for this repository. Use for provider verification, multi-account Gemini checks, SynthID Detector checks at synthid.com, ElevenLabs/Cartesia/Resemble API checks, isolated Playwright checks, or recording oracle evidence. Walk the existing plan automatically when a task needs a provider verdict.

wiltodelta-remove-ai-watermarks-remove-a.description: Removes and identifies AI watermarks and provenance marks in images, video, audio, and text the user generated or edited. Covers Gemini sparkles, SynthID, Microsoft InvisMark, Meta Content Seal, C2PA, EXIF/XMP/IPTC metadata, compatible public AudioSeal/WavMark/Perth v1/SilentCipher audio, and Sora/Veo/Seedance/Doubao/Dola/Hailuo/Vidu/Kling and Wan labels. Use when the user wants to strip or clean AI watermarks and generation labels, or asks whether a file was AI-generated or carries AI provenance, even if they do not name remove-ai-watermarks. Do not use for stock-agency, marketplace,…
wiltodelta-remove-ai-watermarks-remove-a.author: wiltodelta

wiltodelta-remove-ai-watermarks-signal-d.description: Discover missing AI provenance and watermark coverage in the remove-ai-watermarks library from fresh or historical corpora, then validate detection and removal parity. Use for corpus gap mining, periodic signal audits, new-provider discovery, or deciding whether old retained data must be replayed. Do not use for ordinary per-file identification or removal.
